03278 Ya`el {yaw-ale'}

與 03277 同; 陰性專有名詞

AV - Jael 6; 6

雅億 = "山羊"
1) 基尼人希百的妻子, 在西西拉將軍沉睡時, 將一個橛子釘入他的鬢邊, 直穿到地上釘死
record.edic_text:
03278 Ya`el {yaw-ale'}

the same as 03277;; n pr f

AV - Jael 6; 6

Jael = "mountain goat"
1) the wife of Heber the Kenite who killed the general Sisera as he
   slept by driving a peg through his temples into the ground
